eyelid.songTitle: Now That Your Dollar Bills Have Sprouted Wings
eyelid.line: With IOUs glued to my eyelids
stanza: Well, I came to town on a pile of diamonds
Now I'm leaving on a wheelbarrow of dust
With IOUs glued to my eyelids
Sitting here watching my safe rust

eyelid.line: Just paint two crosses on my eyelids
stanza: You’ve been falling short of golden
I’ve been every kind of wrong
I guess I’m dying to let you ruin me
And you’ve been sinking all year long
But if that chariot they’re driving
Don’t swing low enough for us
Just paint two crosses on my eyelids
And point me out of touch

eyelid.songTitle: The Island: Come and See; The Landlord’s Daughter; You’ll Not Feel the Drowning
